refused.message:
refusal[ESS-SYNTH-008]: outcome desk.ticket.Comment/no-such-ticket has no scenario `desk.ticket.Comment/outcome/no-such-ticket`
  its strategy is `default_branch` and it declares no guard
  help: `TestStrategy` and `OutcomeCondition` have drifted apart in `ess-domain`

desk.ticket.CloseTicket/outcome/closed.purpose: `desk.ticket.CloseTicket` answers `closed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.CloseTicket/outcome/no-such-.purpose: `desk.ticket.CloseTicket` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-ticket` and reports `desk.ticket.TicketNotFound`

desk.ticket.Comment/outcome/commented.purpose: `desk.ticket.Comment` answers `commented` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.Comment/outcome/refused-clos.purpose: `desk.ticket.Comment` answers `refused-closed` for an input selecting the branch in its established subject state

desk.ticket.DeleteTicket/outcome/deleted.purpose: `desk.ticket.DeleteTicket` answers `deleted` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.DeleteTicket/outcome/no-such.purpose: `desk.ticket.DeleteTicket` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-ticket` and reports `desk.ticket.TicketNotFound`

desk.ticket.Escalate/outcome/escalated.purpose: `desk.ticket.Escalate` answers `escalated` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.Escalate/outcome/pager-refus.purpose: `desk.ticket.Escalate` answers `pager-refused` for the cause it declares as external, injected

desk.ticket.Escalate/outcome/quiet.purpose: `desk.ticket.Escalate` answers `quiet` for an input that satisfies that branch's guard

desk.ticket.Escalate/outcome/throttled.purpose: `desk.ticket.Escalate` answers `throttled` for the cause it declares as external, injected

desk.ticket.OpenTicket/outcome/negative-.purpose: `desk.ticket.OpenTicket` answers `negative-estimate` for an input that satisfies that branch's guard

desk.ticket.OpenTicket/outcome/opened.purpose: `desk.ticket.OpenTicket` answers `opened` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.ReopenTicket/outcome/no-such.purpose: `desk.ticket.ReopenTicket` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-ticket` and reports `desk.ticket.TicketNotFound`

desk.ticket.ReopenTicket/outcome/reopene.purpose: `desk.ticket.ReopenTicket` answers `reopened` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.Reprioritize/outcome/forbidd.purpose: `desk.ticket.Reprioritize` answers `forbidden` for an independently observed subject enum fact and an eligible input

desk.ticket.Reprioritize/outcome/kept-hi.purpose: `desk.ticket.Reprioritize` answers `kept-high` for an independently observed subject enum fact and an eligible input

desk.ticket.Reprioritize/outcome/no-such.purpose: `desk.ticket.Reprioritize` for an identity no record carries takes `no-such-ticket` and reports `desk.ticket.TicketNotFound`

desk.ticket.Reprioritize/outcome/reprior.purpose: `desk.ticket.Reprioritize` answers `reprioritized` for an input no other branch's guard claims

desk.ticket.Ticket/state/Closed/refuses/.purpose: `desk.ticket.CloseTicket` does not move a `desk.ticket.Ticket` that is in `Closed`, and reports `desk.ticket.TicketStateConflict`
`desk.ticket.Comment` refuses in held state `Closed` without effects

desk.ticket.Ticket/state/Open/refuses/de.purpose: `desk.ticket.ReopenTicket` does not move a `desk.ticket.Ticket` that is in `Open`, and reports `desk.ticket.TicketStateConflict`
